scope: Target-independent prospective generic Czech ASCII-26 MASC wordless qualification; no historical item assigned.
alphabet: Latin A-Z26, corpus NFKD accents removed for this explicitly limited model. No claim about actual historical alphabets.
training_corpus_file_role: public UD Czech train-la language resource, never historical cipher training
test_corpus_file_role: public UD Czech dev language resource, six distinct document-contained excerpts where available, no train/development overlaps; reject duplicate/same-document intersections
configuration: One fixed SA configuration, at most64restarts and at most100000iterations/restart per control; reduce uniformly before all inference if preflight runtime estimate needs it. Record exact final frozen setting.
plaintext_or_observed_key_PASS_threshold: At least5/6 exact plaintext recoveries across6independent positive excerpts; observed-key agreement and exact forward rates also report. If6independent excerpts are unavailable or inputs overlap, profile unqualified.
negative_limits: Three shuffled controls are a falsification diagnostic only; no significant p-value/family-dominance or language-identification claim.
historical_domain_limit: Modern corpus and idealized substitutions do not certify1903 handwriting/old spelling/errors/transcription/othercipherfamilies. Later exact-case source matching remains required.
